task_definition.task_name: Geographic Coordinate Conversion to Gauß-Krüger CRS

task_description.overview: Transform station coordinates from geographic WGS84 (EPSG:4326) to the regional Gauß-Krüger coordinate system (EPSG:31468).
steps: Load the list of station latitude and longitude values in WGS84.
Initialize the pyproj Proj objects for source CRS (EPSG:4326) and target CRS (EPSG:31468).
Use pyproj.transform to convert the longitude and latitude arrays to x and y coordinates in Gauß-Krüger.
Return or store the transformed x and y coordinate arrays for further geospatial analysis.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Convert the provided station coordinates (latitude and longitude in WGS84) to the Gauß-Krüger (EPSG:31468) coordinate system using pyproj. Input: latitudes, longitudes, source EPSG code '4326', target EPSG code '31468'. Output: arrays of x and y coordinates in Gauß-Krüger CRS. Save the conversion results to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}.
